title: S2-Track: A Simple yet Strong Approach for End-to-End 3D Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Core UPD loss has a demonstrated likelihood/sign/scope discrepancy; historical implementation unknown.

problems.title: Printed UPD objective is not a Gaussian negative log-likelihood
problems.claim: Section3.3 Eq6 called NLL and incorporated by Eq10 with positive coefficient
assumptions: m=mu=0 allowed; no scale upper bound stated
problems.check: Exact log-density calculation and expected loss under standard normal epsilon; independent quadrature at four positive scales
problems.result: Printed expected component decreases as -log(sqrt(2pi)*sigma)/sqrt2; NLL increases as log(sqrt(2pi)*sigma)+1/2
problems.counterevidence: Text may intend true NLL; no code available to establish implemented loss; ablation can survive typography error
problems.impact: Invalid mathematical specification of core UPD component. No claim that full objective diverges or empirical gains fail.
problems.correction: Correct negative log-density identity proved; complete uncertainty-learning repair not verified

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read physical p4 Gaussian reparameterization, p5 Eq6 and positive full-loss weighting Eq10, and p12 AppendixA.2.3. Visually inspected p5 to verify exact parentheses and sign rather than relying on extraction.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: The source says mean and standard deviation are learned from q,k, alpha=mu+sigma*epsilon with standard-normal epsilon. A zero dot-product target m and learned mean mu=0 are admissible; sigma>0. No scale bound is present in the inspected specification.
independent_verification.decisive_check: Taking minus log of the normal density gives log(sqrt(2pi)*sigma)+r^2/(2sigma^2). At fixed r=0, printed and correct derivatives in sigma are -1/sigma and +1/sigma. Under actual reparameterization r=sigma*epsilon, Gaussian integration yields E[exp(-epsilon^2/2)]=1/sqrt2, so the printed expected component has derivative -1/(sqrt2*sigma); the NLL expectation has derivative +1/sigma. Existing four-scale quadrature output matches these independently derived expressions.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: A typesetting error plus correct implementation remains plausible because the prose names NLL, and the release is unavailable. Extending the log alone leaves the wrong minimization sign; variance/std reparameterization does not fix it. Bounded scales can prevent divergence but cannot restore the likelihood identity.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Major retained for the demonstrated invalid mathematical objective of core UPD: Eq10 explicitly includes Eq6 with coefficient1. This does not show divergence of the complete tracking loss or invalidate empirical gains. The survival of empirics is separate from this core-specification error.
independent_verification.repair_scope: The corrected NLL is an exact density identity only. It does not certify calibration, an implemented training pipeline, or a complete uncertainty method; scale collapse at zero residual is correctly noted.
independent_verification.scope_and_surviving_evidence: Read Tables2-3 p7: .663-.574=.089, same-backbone .608-.574=.034; ablation changes relative to .394 are .044,.024,.029,.064. Their arithmetic is consistent and does not remove the specified-loss error.
